items.name: aluminium-plate-hero
items.title: Aluminium Plate Hero
items.description: Block: Hero for hardware and tooling. A sheet of brushed aluminium, as a full-bleed hero. The brushing is two noise filters stretched along the grain. Move your pointer and a highlight runs along it, breaking up on the grain, with a softer second reflection; on touch it drifts by itself.

items.name: answer-desk
items.title: Answer Desk
items.description: Block: Searchable FAQ section. An FAQ section made as a help desk: a search field in a recessed well with an LCD that counts the answers that match, topic keys with a lamp for the chosen one, the questions as numbered rows with your words marked, and the answer on a reading panel that asks whether it helped.

items.name: api-keys
items.title: API keys
items.description: Block: API key settings page. A developer makes, copies and revokes the keys that connect their own tools to the account: a table of keys, a create dialog that shows the new key once, and a curl example beside the webhook events.

items.name: attract-cta
items.title: Attract CTA
items.description: Block: Newsletter signup band. A newsletter band whose button is a magnet. As the pointer comes near, brass filings behind it turn, stream in and stand round it in a bristling ring, and stay there.

items.name: camera-launch
items.title: Camera Launch
items.description: Block: Launch hero for optical products. A launch hero for a fast prime, where the lens is the Iris. Turn its aperture ring and the photograph beside it follows: round bokeh wide open, nine-sided points stopped down.

items.name: cassette-teardown
items.title: Cassette Teardown
items.description: Block: Exploded view of a cassette. The Cassette comes apart from the front as you scroll: the top shell with its window, the tape path, the two reels, the pressure pad on its spring, the guide rollers and the bottom shell, each casting its shadow on the bench from one lamp.

items.name: client-plates
items.title: Engraved Client Plates
items.description: Block: Client logo strip. “Used in production by…”, as metal name plates. Brushed aluminium or anodised black, screwed or riveted, each client’s mark cut into the metal with one quiet number under it.

items.name: cloth-cubes
items.title: Cloth-lit Cubes
items.description: Block: Features as small lit devices. Cubes in speaker cloth on a desk, one per feature, each with its icon lit through the weave. One shows its figure on lamps, one breathes as the live one, and each brightens under your pointer.

items.name: colophon
items.title: Colophon
items.description: Block: Footer with index and region switch. A footer made as the rating plate and the index of a product. An engraved plate with the model, the serial and the specification, a contents-page index with leader dots, a five-detent rotary switch for language and region, a service lamp and a top key.

items.name: crowdfund-flask
items.title: Crowdfund Flask
items.description: Block: Crowdfunding total and rewards. A fundraiser where the total is honey in a flask. It pours to the share raised on first view and counts the pounds on its enamel patch; every reward backed pours a little more in.

items.name: dark-hero
items.title: Dark Hero
items.description: Block: Dark hero for studios and products. A pool of black ferrofluid under an editorial headline. It follows your pointer from anywhere on the section and rises into spikes beneath it before the headline has been read.

items.name: departures-board
items.title: Departures Board
items.description: Block: Live departures and schedules. A departures board of flip-dot lines under an enamel fascia. A train starts boarding, another slips five minutes, the first departs and every row below moves up in a clattering cascade.

items.name: dial-teardown
items.title: Dial Teardown
items.description: Block: Exploded view of a rotary dial. The Detent Dial comes apart along its shaft as you scroll: cap, knurled body, scale plate, a brass detent ring with the pawl's roller sitting in a notch, and the back plate, each casting its shadow on the next from one lamp.

items.name: dispatch
items.title: Dispatch
items.description: Block: Contact form with a printed receipt. A contact section made as a desk unit. A machined form with a segmented topic selector and a send key that locks while the message goes, and the Receipt Printer beside it, which prints the confirmation as a ticket with a reference number.

items.name: drop-tray
items.title: Drop Tray
items.description: Block: Mega menu header. A site header whose section keys latch down and drop a recessed tray of pages from under the bar: two printed columns, a line under each page, and a raised plate for the page to see. On a phone the sections fold into a Menu key and a sheet.

items.name: faq-drawer
items.title: FAQ Index
items.description: Block: FAQ accordion section. An FAQ as a card-index drawer. Each question is typed along a card’s edge with its subject on a staggered tab; pull one and it lifts out to show the answer. An accordion underneath.

items.name: field-404
items.title: Field 404
items.description: Block: 404 page you magnetise into view. A 404 on a sheet of lost steel filings. As the visitor moves, a field-strength readout climbs and the iron slowly finds 404. The copy owns the joke; two plain links lead out.

items.name: fluted-glass-hero
items.title: Fluted Glass Hero
items.description: Block: Warm hero for lighting and audio. A wall of ribbed glass with one warm lamp drifting slowly behind it, as a full-bleed hero. Every rib refracts the lamp into its own slice of light, with a lit edge, a faint caustic and a soft colour at the hot core.

items.name: goal-tally
items.title: Goal Tally
items.description: Block: Fundraiser total and supporters. A fundraiser’s total on big printed drums. They roll up as each pledge lands, beside a feed of named supporters and a lane-rope rail to the goal. Pledge, and your £25 carries through.

items.name: hand-press-launch
items.title: Hand Press Launch
items.description: Block: Coming-soon page with signup. A coming-soon section revealed by a hand. As it scrolls into view a palm presses into a pin board from behind, fingertips last, and stays; the date and a real signup sit beside it.

items.name: hifi-volume
items.title: Hi-Fi Volume
items.description: Block: Product hero for premium audio. An amplifier hero in walnut and brushed brass. The input selector snaps and lights its legend, the attenuator clicks 2 dB a step, and two VU needles swing to what the music would read.

items.name: impression-hero
items.title: Impression Hero
items.description: Block: Brand name hero for studios. A studio’s hero on a full-bleed board of brass pins. The brand word rises out of it under a raking lamp, and the visitor’s hand lifts the pins between the nav and the headline.

items.name: instrument-rack
items.title: Instrument Rack
items.description: Block: Feature grid of working instruments. A bento grid of feature cells made as a rack of machined panels. Each holds a small working instrument: a segmented counter, a needle meter with weight, a row of region lamps, a detent knob you turn, an LCD clock.

items.name: iron-hero
items.title: Iron Hero
items.description: Block: Hero for science and engineering. A magnetics company’s opening, set like a physics monograph. On the mounted plate below, the name is written in iron filings that swing after the pointer and settle back into the word.

items.name: light-table
items.title: Light Table
items.description: Block: Gallery for photographers and studios. A portfolio gallery made as an edit table: slides in their mounts on opal glass lit from below, the chosen one lifted off it and shown whole in a viewer with its title, place, year and exposure, transport keys and a counter, series keys, and a switch for the table's light.

items.name: machined-footer
items.title: Machined Footer
items.description: Block: Footer with live status. A footer made as the bottom panel of a device. Printed columns of links, a status window with a real lamp, a changelog key, an Aluminium / Graphite switch for the whole page, the build number stamped in.

items.name: morning-blinds-hero
items.title: Morning Blinds Hero
items.description: Block: Daylight hero for calm sites. Morning light through window blinds on a plaster wall, as a full-bleed hero. The bands have soft edges, a window bar casts one shadow across them, the floor bounces a little warmth back, and the shadows shift slightly. Pure CSS.

items.name: nameplate-wall
items.title: Nameplate Wall
items.description: Block: Customer list without logos. A customers section made as the tenant directory in a lobby: cast aluminium or graphite plates, each as long as its name, with the name in engraved capitals and a small “Since 2021” line, fixed to a board behind a sheet of glass that one slow band of light crosses.

items.name: notifications-page
items.title: Notifications page
items.description: Block: Notifications and alert settings. Every alert the account has sent, under date rules and a tab for what is unread, with a panel of switches that turn each kind down.

items.name: odometer-teardown
items.title: Odometer Teardown
items.description: Block: Exploded view of a drum counter. The Odometer comes apart along its axle as you scroll: the face plate with its window, five number drums, the carry pinions that hand a turn from one drum to the next, the axle, the side frames and the drive gear, each casting its shadow on the bench from one lamp.

items.name: patch-bay
items.title: Patch Bay
items.description: Block: Integrations and routing section. A rack panel of jacks with a cable hanging from each source. Carry a plug to where the events should go and it seats with a click; the lamp beside it lights for every event the cable carries.

items.name: pin-404
items.title: Pin 404
items.description: Block: 404 page you wipe flat. A pin board with 404 standing out of it. Wipe it flat with your pointer; a moment later it climbs back up, because the page is still missing.

items.name: pin-screen-teardown
items.title: Pin Screen Teardown
items.description: Block: Exploded view of a pin board. The Pin Screen comes apart from the front as you scroll: the machined frame, the pressed pins standing out in the shape of a word, the bed of flush pins, the guide plate with a hole for every pin, the back plate and the case, each casting its shadow on the bench from one lamp.

items.name: pocket-player
items.title: Pocket Player
items.description: Block: Audio player for recordings. A pocket cassette player for your recordings. PLAY latches down; STOP springs it back and, stopped, pops the door open on its spring. Choose a recording and it swaps the tape and plays.

items.name: portfolio-iris
items.title: Portfolio Iris
items.description: Block: Photo portfolio with filters. A photographer’s index where every frame is a shutter. Photographs peek through graphite blades, open whole on hover or focus, and shut where they stand when a filter leaves them out.

items.name: pricing-drums
items.title: Pricing Drums
items.description: Block: Pricing with a plan toggle. A price printed on brass drums. Switch the period or the currency and the figure rolls to its new value with the period engraved beneath; a tally shows the founder seats actually left.

items.name: processing-state
items.title: Processing State
items.description: Block: Progress for long jobs. A long job’s progress card, crowned by ferrofluid. The dish breathes with the work, surges as each of four steps completes, and settles to a mirror under the word “Balanced.”

items.name: proof-sheet
items.title: Proof Sheet
items.description: Block: Long-read article layout. A long-read layout set like a journal proof: the essay in one column with its notes in the margin, and a contents plate beside it whose lamps follow the section you are reading, an LCD of minutes left from where you are, and keys for the size of the type.

items.name: rail
items.title: Rail
items.description: Block: Site navigation bar. A site's top bar made like the front edge of a hi-fi unit. A debossed wordmark plate, engraved links with a lit lamp under the current page, a search key and a call-to-action key with a real skirt. It condenses on scroll and folds into a Menu key and drawer on a narrow bar.

items.name: reading-progress
items.title: Reading Progress
items.description: Block: Reading progress for long reads. A long read with a test tube for a progress bar. The tube in the margin fills with ink as the essay is read, and sloshes when the reader skims.

items.name: roll-call
items.title: Roll Call
items.description: Block: Team page with portraits. A team section on a machined roll board beside a light box: a row per person with a staff number, name, role, the year they started and a lamp. Call a row up and the person is set in the light box’s halftone screen, a dot at a time in a wipe across the glass, with their nameplate under it.

items.name: rotary-file
items.title: Rotary File
items.description: Block: Testimonials you flip through. A testimonials section on a motorised rotary card file: each customer a paper card on the drum, the one in front readable, the ones to come leaning back with their name tabs showing. Press a customer’s key on the plinth and the drum riffles round to their card while a fluorescent window counts the cards past.

items.name: scoreboard
items.title: Scoreboard
items.description: Block: Live match centre. A match centre round a flip-dot scoreboard. Big amber numbers and a clock counting real seconds; a goal ripples the whole board outward before the number turns over.

items.name: search-results
items.title: Search results
items.description: Block: Global search results page. What global search returns when the question is a client, an invoice number or a note: a search well, a live count, kind tabs, filters and rows that open.

items.name: shutter-preloader
items.title: Shutter Preloader
items.description: Block: Preloader and page transition. A studio landing page that loads behind a shutter. The Iris breathes over the hero while a counter runs on its blades, then opens as the headline rises; every nav link closes it again.

items.name: socket-panel
items.title: Socket Panel
items.description: Block: Connected integrations panel. An integrations section made as a panel of sockets, one per service. A connected service has its plug seated and a green lamp; press a free socket and the plug goes in with a seat, press a connected one and the panel asks, in place, whether to unplug it.

items.name: speaker-launch
items.title: Speaker Launch
items.description: Block: Launch hero for audio hardware. A speaker launch where the product works on the page. Press Play and a loop made in the browser lifts a gold bowl of ferrofluid into spikes on every kick.

items.name: spec-sheet
items.title: Spec Sheet
items.description: Block: Plan comparison table. Plans side by side as a manufacturer’s data sheet: a printed title block, then one table with a lit lamp for what a plan has and the same lamp unlit for what it lacks, one column lifted as a raised strip, the heads stuck to the top of a long table, and two at a time on a phone.

items.name: specimen-case
items.title: Specimen Case
items.description: Block: Features as objects under glass. A bento of glass-topped compartments in a machined case, each holding one real Tactile object running small (the Odometer, the Flip-Dot, the Detent Dial, the Vessel) with an engraved label card under the glass. Light comes from above: hover, focus or press Light and that case wakes; the others sleep.

items.name: switchboard
items.title: Switchboard
items.description: Block: Contact section for several teams. A contact section made as an operator's switchboard. A row of labelled jacks, one per desk, each with a lamp that is lit when someone is there; choosing one seats a plug and draws a cord, and opens that desk's short form or its direct email and phone. The desk hours sit on an LCD clock in the visitor's own time zone.

items.name: synth-panel
items.title: Synth Panel
items.description: Block: Product hero for synths and pedals. A synthesiser’s live front panel. Turn any of seven machined dials and the scope redraws the filtered, driven waveform before a note is heard.

items.name: tariff-slide
items.title: Tariff Slide
items.description: Block: Pricing for usage-based plans. A pricing section made as a slide rule. Drag the glass runner along a logarithmic usage scale and read the price off the scale beneath; the plan lamp lights, and a lever slides the price scale to its annual place.

items.name: team-and-roles
items.title: Team and roles
items.description: Block: Team invites and roles. An owner invites people to a workspace, sets what each one can open with a role and sees who has not accepted, in a table with a search, filters, a roles legend and a bulk bar.

items.name: thermostat
items.title: Thermostat
items.description: Block: Climate control with a schedule. A home-climate section with a glazed ceramic dial. It clicks at every degree, draws the work left as an arc from the room to the set point, and turns itself when you pick a time of day.

items.name: ticker
items.title: Ticker
items.description: Block: Announcement bar. An announcement bar made as a ticker-tape window. A paper tape in the Receipt Printer’s stock and typewriter face runs behind a glass lip a character cell at a time, holds still when you go near it, and closes with a key that has weight.

items.name: trip-computer
items.title: Trip Computer
items.description: Block: Stats band with live figures. An instrument cluster as a stats band. An odometer with red tenths, a trip meter whose Reset winds the drums back to nought, the range counting down. One preset turns it into a SaaS band.

items.name: upload-vessel
items.title: Upload Vessel
items.description: Block: File upload dialog. A file-import dialog where the upload fills a beaker. Water pours in with the bytes, fizzes while the files are checked, and stands full with a tick when the data is ready.

items.name: venue-marquee
items.title: Venue Marquee
items.description: Block: Tonight's line-up for venues. A club’s site on the night, under a brass flip-dot marquee. Tonight’s acts clatter in one at a time, amber discs resolving into a name, over the running order and the tickets.

items.name: warm-up
items.title: Warm-up
items.description: Block: Page preloader that tracks the load. A page preloader made as a row of valves warming up. The filaments come up one after another, cold wire to amber to a white-hot core, as the page really loads; an anode meter swings up and the Phosphor Scope draws a clean sine. Then the row dims and the panel lifts off the page.

items.name: annunciator
items.title: Annunciator
items.description: Object: Alarm panel for status and incidents. An alarm panel: a grid of engraved windows, dark until a fault trips. A new fault flashes amber or red and sounds a horn; ACK holds it steady; when it clears it goes dark, or flashes slowly until RESET; TEST lights every lamp. The sequence plants have used for fifty years.

items.name: baize
items.title: Baize
items.description: Object: Handheld game: eight-ball pool. A pool table you could hold, with real physics: felt with its nap under one raking lamp, rails of wood or metal, six pockets with depth. Pull back anywhere on the table to aim, let go to strike.

items.name: cassette
items.title: Cassette
items.description: Object: Progress bar for uploads and playback. A clear cassette as a progress bar. The right pack grows as the work goes on and the hubs turn while it runs, the emptier one faster. Your finger winds the tape.

items.name: chladni
items.title: Chladni Plate
items.description: Object: Tuning control for audio products. A black plate on a shaker, strewn with sand, with a frequency knob. Turn it onto a resonance and the plate sings: the sand walks off the parts that move and gathers on the lines that stand still. Bow it along an edge, lay a finger on it, tap it: it answers where you touch it.

items.name: cloth-beacon
items.title: Cloth Beacon
items.description: Object: Status light for agents and builds. A status light made of cloth: a capsule of stretched fabric in a machined plate with a lamp behind it. Standing by glows dim behind the icon, listening breathes, working is a pool of amber travelling the strip, attention flashes twice and holds, done is green and an error red. The words glow through the weave.

items.name: cloth-fader
items.title: Cloth Fader
items.description: Object: Volume and brightness faders. Volume faders in capsules of stretched cloth, lit from behind. The level is light rising from the bottom with a soft edge in the weave, and the number and icon glow through. Drag one and the light follows a moment late; press twice to mute. One fader, or a strip of up to six.

items.name: compass
items.title: Compass
items.description: Object: Heading input and readout. A liquid-damped compass. The card swings past the mark and settles while a lit display reads the bearing. Your hand turns the knurled bezel, one click a degree.

items.name: composing-stick
items.title: Composing Stick
items.description: Object: Headline entrance for heroes and 404s. A printer's composing stick that sets your heading in metal type. Slugs drop one at a time into the steel stick, a quoin turns to lock the line, and the bodies sink away to leave the page's own text.

items.name: cursor-puck
items.title: Cursor Puck
items.description: Object: Weighted cursor for playful pages. A weighted puck on a short spring, under the pointer. It never sits where the pointer is: it lags behind, then catches up, with a coiled spring, not a dotted line, showing the stretch and compression.

items.name: dash
items.title: Dash
items.description: Object: Handheld game: lane runner. A three-lane runner as a handheld made of kit parts, on a printed segment LCD. Change lanes to run past the hurdles; three falls end the run, and the track quickens every ten hurdles.

items.name: deck
items.title: Deck
items.description: Object: Audio player for music apps. A player for a DJ booth, made of the kit's own materials. A screen with the whole loop as an overview strip and a zoomed waveform scrolling past the playhead on its beat grid, both drawn from the audio you hear; a jog wheel you scratch and nudge; cue and play keys; a tempo fader; up to eight pads; and a back panel you flip to, where the line out plugs in.

items.name: detent-dial
items.title: Detent Dial
items.description: Object: Rotary control for levels and selectors. A rotary control you count by feel. The value sticks at each notch and clicks over, and the light stays where the lamp is. Not a slider in a round costume.

items.name: ferrofluid
items.title: Ferrofluid
items.description: Object: Playable hero or empty state. Ferrofluid in a dish. It gathers toward the pointer and erupts into sharp spikes, then melts back into a trembling puddle. Your pointer is the magnet.

items.name: filings
items.title: Filings
items.description: Object: Brand name hero in iron filings. Iron filings on paper, magnets underneath. Thousands of slivers swing into a real field and write a hidden word in iron, lit from one lamp. Your pointer is one more magnet.

items.name: flip-dot
items.title: Flip-Dot
items.description: Object: Live sign for boards and scores. The flip-dot display from buses and stations. Every disc swings over, hits its stop, bounces and latches, so each message arrives as a clattering wave. One sign, or a board of them.

items.name: globe
items.title: Globe
items.description: Object: Map of regions and their health. A desk globe on a meridian: a satin-metal ball with the land etched into it, held in a machined half-meridian on a turned stand. Flick it and it coasts to a stop; markers are small domed lamps that light the metal around them and go behind the limb.

items.name: iris
items.title: Iris
items.description: Object: Image reveal for heroes and galleries. A lens’s iris diaphragm, as a reveal. Curved blades pivot on their pins, close to a pinhole and open onto what lies beneath. Turn the knurled ring and they follow, clicking into the nearest f-stop.

items.name: kerb
items.title: Kerb
items.description: Object: Handheld game: road crossing. A crossing game on a dot-matrix LCD handheld: hop a hedgehog over five lanes of traffic, then over the river on drifting logs, to the five burrows in the hedge.

items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: Object: World map for traffic and routes. A world map drawn in lamps behind smoked glass, in a machined bezel. Land is dim unlit domes, the sea is empty glass. Places light as small clusters, packets step lamp to lamp along the great circle between them, and the glass zooms to a region with the same lamp pitch. Point at a place and its engraved plate comes up.

items.name: membrane
items.title: Membrane
items.description: Object: Brand name hero lit by pressing. A foam wall that dents where you press it and comes back slowly, like memory foam. Letters cut into the rim glow brighter the harder you push near them.

items.name: mixer
items.title: Mixer
items.description: Object: Mixing console for audio apps. A DJ mixer, the desk the decks plug into, made of the kit's own materials. Two channels by default, up to eight, each with a trim, three-band EQ, a colour filter, a cue key and a fader beside its LED ladder. The EQ and filter knobs click at the middle; the crossfader has three curves. Press its flip key and it turns over to show the line ins and the master out.

items.name: notebook
items.title: Ring-bound Notebook
items.description: Object: Changelog you turn page by page. A flip book of cards on two rings, seen from above. Lift the lower card over the rings and the page turns: your finger holds the card where it took it, and let go, gravity decides which way it falls.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: Object: Counter for prices and live tallies. A mechanical drum counter. A digit moves only while the one to its right carries, so 1,099 to 1,100 rolls three drums over together. Not a number that fades into another.

items.name: phosphor-scope
items.title: Phosphor Scope
items.description: Object: Radar and scope for monitoring. A cathode-ray tube behind smoked glass. The beam leaves light behind it: a radar sweep lights your contacts and they fade, a trace glows where the signal lingers. Real afterglow, not a blur.

items.name: pin-screen
items.title: Pin Screen
items.description: Object: Brand name hero in pins. The pin-art toy, as a surface. Press a word through polished pins under a raking lamp, drag it, wipe it, or shake it flat. The shape behind is the mould.

items.name: printer
items.title: Receipt Printer
items.description: Object: Printed output for orders and answers. A thermal receipt printer that prints any text, line by line. The paper feeds out past a serrated steel tear bar in the head's own rhythm and curls a little as it grows. Drag the paper down past the resistance and it rips along the teeth and falls away.

items.name: pull-cord
items.title: Pull-cord Bulb
items.description: Object: Light and dark mode switch. A pendant lamp that is a switch. Pull the acorn on its textile cord or ball chain: the detent resists and snaps, and the filament warms from dull red to white while the lamp sways. It can switch the whole page’s finish, the new one opening from the bulb.

items.name: quarry
items.title: Quarry
items.description: Object: Handheld game: falling blocks. Falling blocks on the library's Flip-Dot board, as a handheld made of kit parts. Move and turn pieces to fill whole rows; a full row flips over as a wave of discs and the stack comes down.

items.name: reaction-timer
items.title: Reaction Timer
items.description: Object: Handheld game: reaction test. A one-lamp reaction timer as a handheld made of kit parts. Press Start, wait for the lamp, then hit the key as fast as you can; five tries make a round, scored on a printed scale.

items.name: reeded-glass
items.title: Reeded Glass
items.description: Object: Hero and locked preview behind glass. A pane of fluted glass on rails. Each reed is a lens that magnifies what is behind and smears it softly sideways, sharp top to bottom, so a word reads from across the room. Slide it aside by its pull and the content is there.

items.name: search-dial
items.title: Search Dial
items.description: Object: Scrubber for video and run logs. The heavy dial of an edit console. JOG steps frames under your finger, SHTL is a spring-return shuttle whose angle is the speed, SCRL is a flywheel you flick and it coasts. J, K and L work as in every editor.

items.name: simon
items.title: Simon
items.description: Object: Handheld game: lamp memory. The four-lamp memory game as a handheld made of kit parts. Watch the lamps, then repeat them on the keys; each round adds one and the lamps get quicker.

items.name: snake
items.title: Snake
items.description: Object: Handheld game: snake. The dot-matrix classic as a handheld made of kit parts. Steer the snake round a field of amber LEDs and eat the blinking dot to grow; it gets quicker every five dots.

items.name: spall
items.title: Spall
items.description: Object: Handheld game: brick breaker. A brick game on the kit's vacuum fluorescent display, as a handheld made of kit parts. Press on the display and the bat follows your finger; knock the wall down brick by brick.

items.name: spectroscope
items.title: Spectroscope
items.description: Object: Hero and wavelength input for optics. A prism splits a lamp's light into its colours, and every colour is traced through the glass, so turning the table slides the spectrum along the scale. The telescope reads the wavelength where it points and names the line when it lands on one.

items.name: stack-tower
items.title: Stack Tower
items.description: Object: Handheld game: stacking tower. The stacking game as a handheld made of kit parts. A milled bar slides across a tall window; drop it on the stack, and whatever hangs over is sheared off and falls.

items.name: swarf
items.title: Swarf
items.description: Object: Handheld game: fixed shooter. A fixed shooter on a vector-tube handheld: hold the line against a formation of loose fasteners that steps, drops, dives and rains swarf on your cover.

items.name: tamp
items.title: Tamp
items.description: Object: Handheld game: blasting maze. A blasting game on a backlit colour LCD handheld: set charges in a yard of pillars and brick, put the wanderers down and find the hatch out.

items.name: vessel
items.title: Vessel
items.description: Object: Gauge for progress and goals. A glass of liquid as a gauge. It pours in when the value rises, sloshes when the page jolts and rings when tapped, lit like lab glassware in a photograph.
